title: Right-size AI safety protocol
summary: Added AGENTS.md guidance requiring AI agents to keep safety controls proportional and avoid redundant operator friction.
reason: The agent contract had strong safety invariants but did not explicitly prevent agents from stacking extra warnings, confirmations, review queues, or checklists on already protected workflows.
behavior_before: AGENTS.md documented non-negotiable media-safety invariants without a balancing rule for usability or redundant guardrails.
behavior_after: AGENTS.md directs agents to reuse existing backend controls, prefer the least cumbersome effective guard, avoid stacked confirmations without a demonstrated gap, and simplify obsolete safety layers.
rollback_plan: Remove the Right-Sized Safety Protocol subsection from AGENTS.md and delete this unreleased change packet.
notes:
Add right-sized safety protocol to prevent redundant AI-added operator friction.
No Python files affected.
